title: cafein-lca: the ITF 'Good to go?' urban transport LCA model in Python
description: A programmatic, golden-master-tested Python reimplementation of the life-cycle assessment model published by the International Transport Forum with Cazzola & Crist (2020), 'Good to Go? Assessing the Environmental Performance of New Mobility'. Computes life-cycle energy use and greenhouse-gas emissions per passenger-km, vehicle-km and vehicle for 56 urban transport modes, decomposed into manufacturing, delivery, use, operational services and infrastructure.
